keyword.zh: 拖拉机泵和电动15的区别

title.zh: 拖拉机带动4100和电动15混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Electric 15 prints a 15 kW motor and a pipe diameter. The tractor page prints 40 kW, a slump range and no pipe diameter.
description.zh: 电动15印 15 kW 电机和管径。拖拉机页印 40 kW 和坍落度范围，不印管径。

h1.zh: 拖拉机带动4100和电动15混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 15 and the Tractor-Driven 4100 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 15 prints a 15 kW motor, 8–10 m³/h, vertical 15–20 m, horizontal 60–80 m and pipe 100–125 mm. The tractor prints power 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 15 MPa, distance 40–100 m / 15–45 m and slump 180–220 mm. Electric 15 prints no pressure and no slump. Aggregate is 1–3 cm on both.
directAnswer.zh: 电动15和拖拉机带动4100是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动15印 15 kW 电机、8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、管径 100–125 mm。拖拉机印功率 40 kW、6–12 m³/h、15 MPa、距离 40–100 m / 15–45 m、坍落度 180–220 mm。电动15不印压力，也不印坍落度。骨料都是 1–3 cm。

heading.en: Where Tractor-Driven 4100 and Electric 15 print different values
heading.zh: 拖拉机带动4100和电动15哪些数值不同

body.en: Theoretical output: Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 6–12 m³/h; Electric 15 prints 8–10 m³/h. Dimensions: Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm; Electric 15 prints 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm. Total weight: Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 1300 kg; Electric 15 prints 450 kg. The same printed value on a shared label: Max. aggregate size is 1–3 cm on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：拖拉机带动4100印 6–12 m³/h；电动15印 8–10 m³/h。外形尺寸：拖拉机带动4100印 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm；电动15印 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm。整机重量：拖拉机带动4100印 1300 kg；电动15印 450 kg。同一标题下数值相同的有：最大骨料粒径两边都是 1–3 cm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Tractor-Driven 4100 prints cells that Electric 15 does not: Power 40 kW; Pumping pressure 15 MPa; Conveying distance (H / V) 40–100 m / 15–45 m; Hopper capacity 0.25 m³; Concrete slump 180–220 mm. Electric 15 prints cells that Tractor-Driven 4100 does not: Motor power 15 kW; Vertical delivery height 15–20 m; Horizontal delivery distance 60–80 m; Delivery pipe diameter 100–125 mm. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 拖拉机带动4100有、电动15没有的行：功率 40 kW；泵送压力 15 MPa；输送距离（水平/垂直） 40–100 m / 15–45 m；料斗容积 0.25 m³；坍落度 180–220 mm。电动15有、拖拉机带动4100没有的行：电机功率 15 kW；垂直输送高度 15–20 m；水平输送距离 60–80 m；输送管内径 100–125 mm。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: A compact electric frame and a tractor-driven frame answer different power questions. Open /en/products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump/ for Tractor-Driven 4100 and /en/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/ for Electric 15. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 紧凑电动底盘和拖拉机带动底盘，回答的是不同的动力问题。看拖拉机带动4100请打开 /zh/products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump/，看电动15请打开 /zh/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Tractor-Driven 4100 print the same theoretical output as Electric 15?
question.zh: 拖拉机带动4100和电动15的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 6–12 m³/h. Electric 15 prints 8–10 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。拖拉机带动4100印 6–12 m³/h。电动15印 8–10 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Tractor-Driven 4100 print the same dimensions as Electric 15?
question.zh: 拖拉机带动4100和电动15的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm. Electric 15 prints 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。拖拉机带动4100印 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm。电动15印 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Tractor-Driven 4100 print the same total weight as Electric 15?
question.zh: 拖拉机带动4100和电动15的整机重量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 1300 kg. Electric 15 prints 450 kg. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。拖拉机带动4100印 1300 kg。电动15印 450 kg。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is power missing on Electric 15?

answer.en: The Electric 15 page does not print that label. Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 40 kW. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 电动15这一页没有印这个标题。拖拉机带动4100印的是 40 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
